headline: European Natural Gas Prices Top 101 Euros Amid Storage Concerns
summary: European benchmark natural gas prices surged above 101 euros per megawatt-hour for the first time since 2022, driven by low regional storage levels as winter approaches.
why: Natural gas is a critical energy input for power generation and industrial manufacturing across Europe, making wholesale price spikes a key driver of regional inflation and energy sector costs.

impacts.name: European Natural Gas
impacts.why: Depleted storage levels ahead of winter directly restricted supply and drove up front-month futures at the TTF.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Historically low winter storage levels and rising seasonal demand pushed European gas benchmarks past the 101-euro mark for the first time since the 2022 energy crisis.
